_help: Add video links to "videos", then run: python3 skill/scripts/make_shorts.py
A link can be plain text, or an object with its own settings, e.g.

By default every strong moment becomes a short. Allowed settings: clips (a number, or "all"), min_score, min_seconds, max_seconds, mode (auto|speech|visual), format (vertical|square|horizontal), captions (true|false), hook (true|false), remove_watermark (true|false: removes a channel watermark from a corner, only for footage you may republish without it), name.
"defaults": {...} applies the same settings to every link.
Finished links are remembered in output/processed.json and skipped next time; add "redo": true to a link to make its shorts again.
